purpose: hard natural-deduction RL targets with reference proofs of 7-12 lines (the pretraining range) whose first move is hard to choose: T0_s0 solves 2-16 of 32 attempts

recipe.generator: Dan's fork gen.Gen (4dcd0e4f), unchanged, the K12 rule set; knobs per config in `generation` (pools/hard12/gen_steer.py CONFIGS). The strict_long stream is the previous pool agent's runs/pools/cands_clean.jsonl (gen_candidates.py, seeds 52000 + 1000 i).
recipe.shape_gate: reference 7-12 lines, formula depth <= 5, prompt <= 156 tokens, reference states <= 386 tokens (K12's maximum), no premise whose negation is also a premise
recipe.rejection_sampling: band_score >= threshold (pools/hard12/score.py: logistic model of T0's k 16 band on the task-1 features; per-batch thresholds in `selection`)
recipe.filter: T0_s0 (runs/stage1/T0_s0/model.pt), k 32, plain arm, no think, T 0.8, line forcing, max_steps 96, max_action 512, Lean-judged (pools/passrate.py); keep 2 <= n_ok <= 16
recipe.exclusion: renaming class or premise-order key in any file of `dedupe.exclusion_files`, then within-set duplicates; pool and test split at random from one deduplicated set
recipe.lean: every kept reference proof Lean-checked (code.thinking.lean.lean_check, 16 workers)

seeds.passrate: per run in `measurement.runs` (args.json seed; chunk c uses seed*1000+c)

pilot.jsonl.summary.json.generator: fork gen.Gen (4dcd0e4f), unchanged; knobs as in `configs`

steer1.jsonl.summary.json.generator: fork gen.Gen (4dcd0e4f), unchanged; knobs as in `configs`

t1v1_pass32_reference_only.note: t0_on_same_*: the selection measurement (2-16 of 32 by construction). t0_fresh_remeasure_*: T0_s0 again on the same 1,000 targets with new seeds (120-127), the fair baseline for T1v1: selecting on a noisy measurement makes a fresh one regress toward the mean.
